article.headline: Las Vegas GP Preview: Verstappen Enters as Favorite for November 19-21 Showdown on the Strip

research.facts:
Las Vegas GP Preview
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Las Vegas GP dates: November 19-21, 2026
- Race day: Saturday night local time (sources mostly agree on Saturday night, some say Sunday Nov 22)
- Verstappen is early betting favorite (13/8 at some bookmakers)
- Circuit: 3.8-mile street circuit, 17 turns, Las Vegas Strip
- No Sprint event at Las Vegas
- Lando Norris warned about narrow tire operating window for 2026 cars
**Sources:** ESPN preview, TheSpread odds, Sky Sports schedule

article.headline: Verstappen Leads Russell by 17, Hamilton Right Behind: F1's P2 Battle Heats Up

research.facts:
P2 Championship Battle
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence — multiple sources agree):**
- Kimi Antonelli: 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion (sealed in Mexico City, Oct/Nov 2026)
- Max Verstappen: P2 in championship after Brazil
- George Russell: leads 3rd place by some margin after Brazil; Verstappen leads Russell by 17 pts
- Lewis Hamilton: 1 point behind Russell for 3rd
- Verstappen cannot catch Antonelli; championship battle is for 2nd place
- 75 points maximum remaining (3 races × 25 pts)
**Sources:** SI F1 standings: https://www.si.com/onsi/f1/news/f1-standings-and-results-after-the-2026-brazilian-grand-prix, Sky Sports

article.headline: Kimi Antonelli: The 20-Year-Old Who Became Formula 1's Youngest World Champion

research.facts:
Antonelli Championship
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence — multiple sources):**
- Kimi Antonelli: youngest F1 champion in history
- Age: approximately 19-20 years old
- Title clinched: Mexico City Grand Prix (Nov 1, 2026)
- Mercedes 2026 Constructors' Champions (sealed in Brazil, Nov 8)
- Antonelli's first F1 season as a full-time driver
- Mercedes' ninth Constructors' Championship, first since 2021
**Sources:** Motorsport Week, Sky Sports, Yahoo Sports (confirmed multiple sources)
